object.name: evi.tone.macro~
object.digest: A 'one knob' macroisation for nonlinear cut tone control useful for quick colourisation in your audio chain
object.description: Similar to <o>evi.damp.macro~</o> but nonlinear so capable of driving audio input hard into the filter. The 'one knob' macroisation takes this into account. The effect is a dark saturated tone control for colourisation. Forms the output stage of <o>evi.valve~</o>.

inlets.description: Audio input to be tone controlled.

attributes.name: smooth
attributes.description: Smooth the internal coefficients controlled by the 'tone' attribute, set in ms. If 0 smoothing is CPU-off.

attributes.name: tone
attributes.description: The one attribute that does everything. At 0 the input signal is very slightly damped with very little nonlinear effect. At 1 the input signal is 100% dark and saturated. 0..1 the saturation gets stronger and the cutoff frequencies move from extremes to the mid range and the shelves attenuate eventually to full low/highpass filters.
